senses.def: Any classification (of the Angiosperms) conforming to the publications of the Angiosperm Phylogeny Group.
The Angiosperm Phylogeny Group: an international group of botanists.
The classification (of the Angiosperms) in the first, 1998, publication by the Angiosperm Phylogeny Group, as distinct from APG II (2003).
The classification (of the Angiosperms) in the second, 2003, publication by the Angiosperm Phylogeny Group, as distinct from previous and subsequent APG classifications published beginning in 1998.
appearance, pulse, grimace, activity, respiration (used to remember how to give a newborn an Apgar score)
A Dutch or North-German surname transferred from the given name
an assessment of the physical condition of a newborn infant; involves heart rate and muscle tone and respiratory effort and color and reflex responsiveness
A zero- to ten-point score given to newborns based on their APGAR vitals.
